assertions.name: orbit_sum_identity_residual
assertions.source: Cl_3(2pi/5) + Cl_3(4pi/5) = -(12/25) zeta(3), from the multiplication formula sum_k Li_3(zeta_5^k) = -(24/25) zeta(3) restricted to real parts; bar is this file's own 1e-40

description: Verification at 50 decimal digits of the orbit-sum identity Cl_3(2π/5) + Cl_3(4π/5) = -(12/25) ζ(3), derived from the multiplication formula Σ Li_3(ζ_5^k) = -(24/25) ζ(3) restricted to real parts. Together with prop:bring-trilog-imaginary-tate-rational (round 10), reduces the 2-dim Bring trilog content to: ζ(3)-line (classical) ⊕ Cl_3(2π/5)-Cl_3(4π/5) (genuinely new, 1 real number).

antisymmetric_generator.interpretation: The genuinely-new depth-3 element for B1 over Q(ζ_5). Lives in P_3 / (P_2 + ζ(3)·Q + Tate).

sharp_open_content_at_depth_3_over_zeta5: ONE real number: Cl_3(2π/5) - Cl_3(4π/5) ≈ 0.955. Whether this admits a closed form modulo lower-weight stuff is open (no Goncharov/Bloch-Suslin reduction beyond round 10's reflection-formula result).
